spec.title: `flow:redbook` — the AI-native development practices, as a collection

p.REDBOOK-IS-A-CURATED-COLLECTION-OF-PRACT: The **redbook** is a curated collection of AI-native development practices distilled from the book *AI-native development* and from the practices proven in the vibevm project's own history.

p.EACH-PRACTICE-IS-A-STANDALONE-FLOW-PACKA: Each practice is a standalone `flow` package — a boot snippet plus protocol documents, product-agnostic, language-agnostic, and agnostic of any particular coding agent.

p.THE-UMBRELLA-NAMES-A-TESTED-SET-AND-CARR: This umbrella package names a **tested set** of them and carries the book itself.

p.REQUIRING-THE-UMBRELLA-INSTALLS-THE-WHOL: Requiring `flow:redbook` installs the whole collection: the members arrive through the dependency closure, each contributing its own boot snippet and its own `spec/flows/<name>/` documents.

p.THE-UMBRELLAS-VERSION-IS-THE-EDITION-NUM: The umbrella's version is the **edition number**.

p.AN-EDITION-IS-A-TESTED-SET-OF-EXACT-PINS: An edition is a tested set: every member is pinned exactly (`=X.Y.Z`), so no member's version can skew inside an edition. The *roster* is a second question — while a wave settles, members are accumulated in place and the edition number moves once at the end (see the manifest's own note above the cultural-extraction wave), so two projects on the same edition run byte-identical text of every member they share.

p.MEMBERS-EVOLVE-BETWEEN-EDITIONS: Members evolve on their own version lines between editions; a new edition is a new umbrella version with refreshed pins.

facts.EDITION-0-1-0: **Edition 0.1.0** — the book's core: the ten flows for the two-process model, the file IPC, and the memory model.
facts.EDITION-0-2-0: **Edition 0.2.0** (the second edition) — added eleven project-practice flows for running a project over the long haul.
facts.EDITION-1-0-0: **Edition 1.0.0** (this edition) — remints the tested collection as the stable 1.0 world.

td.ROW-TWO-PROCESS-MODEL-ONE-LINE: Human and AI as coprocessors; the human owns coherence; files are the only shared memory.

td.ROW-WAL-ONE-LINE: The checkpoint file (WAL) and cold-resume snapshot; session wind-down and resume rituals; the `wal-status` skill.

td.ROW-SYNC-FROM-CODE-ONE-LINE: The sanctioned reverse path: reconcile the spec when code changed first, with human approval.

td.ROW-ATOMIC-COMMITS-ONE-LINE: One commit, one idea; Conventional Commits; pushed history is frozen.

td.ROW-ADDRESSABLE-SPECS-ONE-LINE: `spec://` URIs, stable anchors, size budgets, and the spec tree layout.

td.ROW-DECISION-RECORDS-ONE-LINE: Decisions, not facts: reason + rejected alternatives + revisit trigger, at the governing anchor.

td.ROW-CONFLICT-PROTOCOL-ONE-LINE: Human > Spec > Tests > Code; REVIEW markers; the conservative-default path when the spec is silent.

td.ROW-CAMPAIGN-PLANS-ONE-LINE: Cold-executable campaign plans: phase gates, falsifiable predictions, execution and deferral ledgers.

td.ROW-DISCOVERY-PROMPT-ONE-LINE: The DISCOVERY collaborative-research prompt, packaged verbatim with a usage guide.

td.ROW-ATTRIBUTION-POLICY-ONE-LINE: A deliberate authorship posture: human-authored surface by default, disclosure documented as the alternative.

td.ROW-OPERATING-MODES-ONE-LINE: Codeword-triggered work postures; red lines that survive every mode.

td.ROW-HEALTH-AUDIT-ONE-LINE: The periodic judgment sweep over what the per-commit gate is blind to; a skill and an append-only trend.

td.ROW-MANUAL-TESTS-ONE-LINE: Human-runnable walkthroughs for the integration surfaces automation cannot prove.

td.ROW-SECRETS-HYGIENE-ONE-LINE: Surface-secrets never printed or persisted; scope discipline; third-party-code consent.

td.ROW-LICENSING-ONE-LINE: A deliberate licence posture; permissive-only dependencies; the EULA-to-open path; a drafting skill.

td.ROW-SOURCE-MIRRORS-ONE-LINE: Single-writer multi-homing; manifest-driven fail-loud fast-forward-only fan-out.

td.ROW-SPEC-GENRES-ONE-LINE: Contract vs lore vs research vs plans — what goes where, who wins, two-way links.

td.ROW-COMPARATIVE-RESEARCH-ONE-LINE: Evergreen competitor studies with two-way gap analysis and numbered roadmap deltas.

td.ROW-MANAGED-BLOCKS-ONE-LINE: How a tool writes into files it does not own — one delimited block, deterministic scanning (for tool authors).

td.ROW-QUALIFIED-NAMING-ONE-LINE: Namespaces for package ecosystems: groups, identity tuples, collision vs conflict (for ecosystem designers).

td.ROW-TOOL-DESIGN-LESSONS-ONE-LINE: Paid-for lessons for self-updating tools and package systems.

p.the-collection-takes-its-spirit-from-the: The collection takes the general spirit of the process from the book.

p.THE-FULL-TEXT-SHIPS-UNDER-SPEC-BOOK-RU: The full text ships in this package under `spec/book/ru/` — currently the Russian manuscript, included as-is.

p.AN-ENGLISH-EDITION-WILL-TAKE-PRIORITY-ON: An English edition will sit alongside it and take priority once it exists; until then the Russian text is the reference.

p.THE-BOOK-IS-REFERENCE-DEPTH: The book is reference depth: the member flows carry the operational rules, the book carries the *why* behind all of them.

p.complementary-layers-lead: The redbook and the AI-Native Code Discipline (`flow:org.vibevm.ai-native/core-ai-native` and its language families) are complementary layers:

facts.LAYER-REDBOOK-IS-PURE-METHOD: **redbook** is pure method — its value survives with only a git repository and a markdown editor. Any product, any language, any agent.
facts.LAYER-DISCIPLINE-IS-CODE-ENFORCED-RIGOR: **The Discipline** is code-enforced rigor — pattern cards, gates, and runnable checkers shipped per language.

p.THE-REDBOOK-PACKAGE-IS-CANONICAL-WHERE-T: Where the two describe the same practice, **the redbook package is canonical**: `flow:wal` is the canonical home of the WAL convention and `flow:campaign-plans` of the campaign-plan format. That is this package's position, and the Discipline has not recorded it: as of core-ai-native 0.8.0 its `05-CAMPAIGN-FORM.xml` and `06-WAL-CONVENTION.xml` carry no deferral, so the two remain parallel copies until one lands.

p.UNINSTALLING-THE-UMBRELLA-REMOVES-ONLY-I: Uninstalling the umbrella removes its own files; member packages are removed by uninstalling them individually.

p.THE-BOOK-TEXT-SHIPS-UNDER-THE-SAME-TERMS: The book text under `spec/book/` is the author's manuscript and ships under the same terms.
